source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1952, p. 5 ("County and rural council elections: results"); Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10 ("County and rural council nominations"); Irish News, 7 May 1952, p. 2; Lisburn Standard, 6 June 1952, p. 1 ("Notice of Result of Elections: Lisburn Rural District, election of councillors, 1952")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the district electoral divisions of Lisburn rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. All 15 divisions are taken from the returning officer's notice of result (John M. Shirley, returning officer, Rural Council Offices, Dublin Road, Lisburn, dated 6 June 1952; Lisburn Standard, 6 June 1952, p. 1): Lambeg was the only contested division; nine sole candidates were declared elected, among them a new member for Malone; in Dunmurry, Glenavy, Magheramesk, Aghalee and Montiaghs, where no one was nominated, the retiring members were deemed re-elected. No party labels are printed; places of abode are not reproduced. Hill, the sitting member; Glover.
